pirs.question: Will the Tidö coalition retain a working majority after the September 13, 2026 election?
pirs.notes: Pass-2 recalibration upward (was 0.32) reflecting steady April polling for SD/M and Tidö cohesion through KU34/263/264. L threshold (currently 4.1±0.7) remains the dominant pivot.

pirs.question: Will KU34 §1 (abortion as fundamental right) pass second-vote in the new Riksdag?
pirs.notes: Cross-bloc consensus expected; even S+MP+C cooperation scenario preserves §1.

pirs.question: Will KU34 §2/§3 (association/citizenship limits) pass second-vote in the new Riksdag?
pirs.notes: Conditional on coalition: 0.85 if Tidö renews; 0.50 if S+MP+C cooperation. Lagrådet criticism (HD024149/HD024150) increases political cost.

pirs.question: Will prop. 263 (återvändande) and prop. 264 (vandel) be enacted with current text or substantively amended?
pirs.notes: V motions HD024149/HD024150 cite Lagrådet's exceptional criticism. Tidö majority arithmetic likely sufficient for adoption; ECtHR challenge probability 0.55 over 2 years.

pirs.question: Will Sweden meet NATO 2.5% defence spending by 2027 (Hague Summit commitment)?
pirs.notes: Cross-bloc consensus; Försvarsmaktens utvärderingsrapport (2026-11-01) is key indicator. NATO Hague Summit (2026-06-30) provides confirmation milestone.

pirs.question: Will L (Liberalerna) cross the 4% threshold in the September 13, 2026 election?
pirs.notes: Critical pivot variable. If L fails: Tidö loses 14 seats, S+V+MP+C becomes structural majority (188 seats). High variance in seat allocation simulation (90% CI: 0-18).
